About Professify
Real Cal Poly professors and confirmed Fall 2026 instructors, with ratings synced live from PolyRatings' open API, and live seat, waitlist, and meeting-time data from Cal Poly Class Search. Pick your major and Professify shows who's teaching each required course, how they're rated, and how full each section is — so you can plan the term around the right professors.
Professor ratings are pulled live from PolyRatings' public API (github.com/Polyratings/polyratings), on a 0–4 scale. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Cal Poly, RateMyProfessors, or PolyRatings.
